history_summary: Clarify wheat inoculant stock identification versus GTDB reference populations
history_details: Applied the reviewed source-pinned taxonomy[0] and taxonomy[2] notes and one native inline event. FN0603 has no exact NCBITaxon:158836 crosswalk row and its descriptor resolves by name to three alternatives; FWP1205's NCBITaxon:299767 descriptor has a 296-genome reference population with stored majority fraction0.95. The source's 16S-based stock identities are preserved; neither correspondence establishes a study-stock genome classification, and the crosswalk release is unestablished. This note-only intermediate preserves both unresolved statuses, every existing candidate set and all other biology pending a separately reviewed native mapping transition. No completed mapping, full QC or full-record scientific approval is claimed.
